summary.en: Offline real-time speech-to-text and translation app in Rust; v0.3.3 lists a Windows ARM64 setup installer.
summary.zh-TW: 以 Rust 撰寫的離線即時語音轉文字與翻譯應用程式；v0.3.3 提供 Windows ARM64 安裝程式。

caveats.en: Source covers Windows on Arm in general; RTX Spark was not tested.
caveats.zh-TW: 來源涵蓋一般 Windows on Arm，未針對 RTX Spark 測試。

caveats.en: Unofficial community project; only the installer listing and README were read, and it was not tested on RTX Spark or run.
caveats.zh-TW: 社群專案；只讀了安裝檔清單與 README，未在 RTX Spark 上測試或執行。

evidence.title: VoiceBridge README: Windows 10/11 (x86_64 & ARM64 Copilot+ / Snapdragon X)
